title: Formation of Lanthanide (III) Cubanes to Dimer Assemblies- coordination geometry influence on structure, single-molecule magnetism and photoluminescence

synthesis.procedure: To a mixture of trifluoroacetic acid (0.11 g, 1 mmol), hexafluoroacetylacetone (0.42 g, 2 mmol) and 1,10-phenanthroline (0.18 g, 1 mmol) in ethanol (5 mL) in a vial at 60 °C, freshly prepared 1 M NaOH (3.5 mL) was added, giving a yellow solution. The mixture was heated and stirred for 20 min. Aqueous lanthanum(III) chloride heptahydrate (0.37 g, 1 mmol in 1 mL water) was added; a white solid formed immediately and the mixture was heated for 3 h. The solid was filtered, washed with water and petroleum ether, and recrystallized from acetone/ethanol. The same approach was applied for the other Ln(III) clusters.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (1000 Oe, 300–2 K): χMT = 29.8 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (theory 31.5 for four isolated Gd(III)), nearly constant to 50 K then falling to 18.6 cm3 mol−1 K at 2 K. Spin-Hamiltonian fit gives Jex = −0.052 cm−1 and g = 1.95, confirming weak antiferromagnetic coupling. No SMM study highlighted for this analogue.

properties.summary: Ferromagnetically coupled cubane SMM: χMT = 44.0 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (theory 47.3). Zero-field ac data show slow magnetization relaxation (SMM) but no hysteresis at 2 K. Green Tb(III) emission at RT (5D4→7FJ, λex=350 nm); I(5D4→7F5)/I(5D4→7F6)=4.17; lifetimes 90 μs (RT) and 1505 μs (20 K).

properties.summary: Weak intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling. χMT = 54.6 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (theory 56.7). Zero-dc-field SMM with Orbach/Raman/QTM fit Ueff = 67.0 K, τ0 = 1.22×10−8 s; under 2000 Oe, Ueff = 78.6 K, τ0 = 1.3×10−8 s. Cole–Cole α = 0.09–0.18 (2–8 K). No hysteresis at 2 K.
